name: Amala Foods Plc
summary: Amala Foods Plc does no have significant operations. Previously, the company was engaged in the production and distribution of processed plant-based food products. The company was formerly known as BigDish Plc and changed its name to Amala Foods Plc in February 2021. Amala Foods Plc was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Saint Saviour, Jersey.
